title: Remove the #35123 digest stopgap hook once column-default drift reaches upgraded production databases
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · follow-up named by #36245's own "Afterwards" line ("remove that hook and its pin in the same PR (or a follow-up named here)"), split off by seat repo:objectstack#1 on the card thread's report (comment 7087711856 on #36245, PR #36564).

## What
PR #36564 makes schema drift detection drop a column `DEFAULT` the metadata no longer declares and rewrite one whose literal changed (`drop_column_default`, `set_column_default`, safe items). Those items are applied by a dev restart, a publish, an artifact boot and `os migrate apply`; a normal production boot only logs drift and does not alter existing columns (current rule). `sys_notification_preference` is a service-owned object, so neither publish nor package install touches it.

So the #35123 stopgap (a before-insert hook on `sys_notification_preference` that writes `digest` null when the caller leaves it unset) stays for now: removing it would make every upgraded production database that has not run `os migrate apply` store `'none'` again for an unset digest — the silent opt-out ruling B on #35123 rejects.

## Done when
- The stopgap hook and its pin are removed, in a PR that shows an upgraded database whose `digest` column was created with `DEFAULT 'none'` stores null on an unset insert after a normal production boot (or after whatever step the platform guarantees every upgrade runs).
- Read first: whether safe column-default drift should be applied on a normal production boot, or reached by a guaranteed upgrade step. If that needs the maintainer's choice, triage files it as a decision; this card then waits on it.

reach: one service-owned object today (`sys_notification_preference.digest`); the hook keeps behaviour right meanwhile.
Business reason: a stopgap that outlives its reason is a second source of truth for one field's default.
Reader: the server lane (`packages/drivers/driver-sql` schema sync, the boot path, the notification-preference service).
Dedupe: `#35123 stopgap hook`, `digest default none`, `column default drift production boot` → none.
Blocked-by: #36564
Grade suggestion: p2. Triage decides.
